operations.label: Profile
operations.description: Cut along vectors on the outside, inside or on the line, with tabs, ramps and leads.

params.name: start_depth
params.label: Start depth
params.help: Depth below the material surface where cutting starts

params.name: through
params.label: Cut through material
params.help: Cut to the full material thickness

params.name: overcut
params.label: Cut below bottom
params.help: Extra depth into the spoilboard

params.name: stepdown
params.label: Stepdown (0 = tool)
params.help: Maximum depth per pass; 0 uses the tool's stepdown

params.name: allowance
params.label: Allowance (+ bigger part / − smaller part)
params.help: Material left on the wall, as in ArtCAM. Outside: + cuts the part that much bigger on every side, − smaller. Inside (holes): + leaves the hole that much smaller, − bigger.

params.name: sharp_corners
params.label: Sharp corners
params.help: Keep offset corners sharp instead of rolling around them

params.name: finish_pass
params.label: Finish pass allowance
params.help: Leave this much for a final full depth pass (0 = no finish pass)

params.name: tab_mode
params.label: Tab placement
params.help: Manual positions are edited with 'Edit Tabs' in the toolpath list

params.name: overlap
params.label: Overlap at end
params.help: Continue past the start point to clean the seam

operations.label: Pocket (Area Clearance)
operations.description: Clear the area inside closed vectors; inner vectors become islands.

params.name: rest_from

operations.label: Drilling
operations.description: Drill holes at the centre of each selected vector.

params.name: tip_compensation
params.label: Add drill point length
params.help: Deepen by the drill point so the full diameter reaches the depth

params.name: retract
params.label: Retract height
params.help: Height above the surface where drilling starts and returns to

operations.label: Engrave (Follow Vector)
operations.description: Machine exactly along the vectors; with a V-bit the depth can come from a line width.

operations.label: V-Carve
operations.description: Carve shapes with a V-bit; depth follows the shape width. Optional flat bottom.

params.name: flat_depth
params.label: Flat depth (0 = no limit)
params.help: Maximum carving depth; deeper areas are machined flat

operations.label: Inlay
operations.description: V-carve inlay: the pocket, or the mirrored plug that fits into it.

params.name: flat_depth
params.label: Pocket depth
params.help: Depth of the pocket; wider areas are machined flat at this depth

params.name: glue_gap
params.label: Glue gap
params.help: Space left under the plug in flat areas (the plug starts this much higher)

params.name: margin
params.label: Plug margin (0 = automatic)
params.help: Width of the background carved around the plug

params.name: mirror
params.label: Mirror the plug
params.help: Mirror left/right in place so the plug can be turned over

operations.label: Fluting
operations.description: Machine along vectors with the depth ramping in at the start and out at the end (decorative flutes with ball nose or V-bits).

commands.label: Door / Panel...
commands.tooltip: Cabinet door with stacked panels, decorative grooves and optional toolpaths

params.name: frame
params.label: Frame width
params.help: From the door edge to the panel line

commands.label: Centre Line (Single Line)...
commands.tooltip: Single lines along the middle of closed shapes, e.g. text for single line engraving

params.name: pixel_size
params.label: Resolution (0 = automatic)
params.help: The shapes are rasterised at this pixel size; smaller is finer and slower

commands.label: Vector Doctor...
commands.tooltip: Checks the selection (or the whole sheet) for open, nearly closed, tiny, duplicate and self-crossing vectors, fixes what it can and selects the rest.

commands.label: Rotate 90° Left
commands.tooltip: Turn the selection a quarter turn counter-clockwise about its centre

commands.label: Rotate 90° Right
commands.tooltip: Turn the selection a quarter turn clockwise about its centre

commands.label: Flip Left / Right
commands.tooltip: Mirror the selection about its own centre line

commands.label: Flip Top / Bottom
commands.tooltip: Mirror the selection about its own centre line

commands.label: Copy Along Vector...
commands.tooltip: Select the vectors to copy and one open vector (or select the path last).

params.name: rotate
params.label: Rotate copies to follow the vector

params.name: version
params.label: AutoCAD version
params.help: The release other programs are told the file is from. Try an older one (2000, or R12) when a program does not take the file or does not show its layers.

cdr.install: Nothing has to be installed for most files. For the others LibreOffice (libreoffice.org) or, on Linux, the libcdr tools (apt install libcdr-tools) are used when they are on the computer. Or export the drawing from CorelDRAW as DXF or SVG (File > Export).

strategies: Auto: chosen for the vectors (the shortest of columns, rows and the route)
Follow on: the next start point nearest the end of the last cut
groupings: Inner pieces (göbek) of all parts first, then the outlines
Part by part (its inner pieces, then its outline)
directions: Mirrored with the sweep (clockwise for bottom left → top right)
